rec.name: Competitor / Product Comparison Table Section
rec.status: Static section built (code delivered); dynamic compare-list version built but moved to Backlog as too complex

what.text: A configurable Shopify section called 'CRO | Konkurrenzvergleich' (comparison table). It shows a heading, subheadline, text and CTA button, plus a side-by-side table. Up to 4 products (or 'us vs. others' columns) are compared, each with an image, name, price and 'View' button. Below them sit feature rows (e.g. Driver, Weight, Battery, or 'Ritual guide included: Yes / No'). One column can be highlighted as the 'active' column, e.g. 'WE' vs 'OTHERS'. A dynamic variant (the 'CRO | Dynamic Compare' section) builds the table from products visitors add via a '+ Add to Compare' button, stored in browser localStorage.

why.text: Comparison tables cut decision effort and show the differences between options in one view. Highlighting 'our' column with ticks against competitors' 'No' makes the unique selling points concrete and reduces the doubt that stops purchases. For product ranges, a side-by-side comparison guides undecided visitors to the right variant, which reduces choice paralysis and can raise AOV by steering toward higher-priced options. Reference cases: IMPACT theme 'Sound' preview and the live example on thatspiritualshop.de.

how.text: Static version: add the section to any template. Select products (product pickers) or type the column values by hand. Add one 'row' block per feature, with a label and a value per column. Choose the highlighted column and adjust fonts, sizes, colours and borders. Dynamic version: a '+ Add to Compare' button on collection product cards saves product data (including metafields for specs) to localStorage. The button then changes to a link to the Compare page. A dedicated Compare page renders the saved products. Liquid (server-side) and JS (client-side) are synced with a workaround. Feedback: choosing products only through the section, e.g. with a dropdown, would be less confusing, but this was not built.

items: Heading: text, font, desktop/mobile size, weight, alignment, bottom margin, colour
Subheadline and body text: font, size, alignment (acceptance criteria)
Button: round vs. square style, alignment, colour, text, link (acceptance criteria)
Section background colour, optional opacity (acceptance criteria)
Table width (600–1400px), cell padding, border width and colour
Up to 4 product pickers plus 'active column' selector with its own background colour
Product image max width and bottom margin; product name and price font, size, colour and weight
Separate fonts, sizes (desktop and mobile) and colours for table header, row label and row content
Row blocks: row label plus values for products 1–4
Row height and row spacing, grid alignment with the left label column (acceptance criteria)

dependencies.text: Product metafields for extra spec data in the dynamic version. localStorage for the compare list. A dedicated Compare page. Reference build in the Shopify 'Concept' theme and the IMPACT theme feature. The delivered code is the static section, schema name 'CR0 | Vergleichstabelle'. Source code and setup guide were attached by the developer but are not fully visible in the ticket.

items: Conversion rate on pages with the section
Add-to-cart rate / click-through to the products via the 'View' buttons
Bounce rate and exit rate on the PDP
